content.caption: Waking up to the misty mountains always inspires me to create something nourishing in the kitchen. Today I prepared a simple nasi goreng using fresh ingredients from the garden. The sizzle of the wok and the blend of soy and chili bring such comfort 🌱 Sharing this meal with loved ones feels like the ultimate act of care ❤️
content.cta: What brings you comfort in the kitchen?
